summary: Risk-off session led by chips: Nasdaq down about 1.7% and S&P 500 about 1.1-1.3%, with Nvidia near 159 on CEO turmoil a day before Tuesday's earnings; bias stays bearish on semis with TTWO and JNJ as the bullish spots. Update 10:20 PT: no change; searches again returned no fresh intraday quotes or news on the picks, so levels and confidence are held.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq down ~1.7% at midday on the chip sell-off into Nvidia earnings; under 666 extends the slide, a fill back to the ~680 close negates.

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: Up ~3-4% premarket on strong GTA VI presales ahead of Thursday's release, Jefferies reiterates buy; a push over the 237.5 premarket high extends, losing the ~229.4 trendline fails the gap.

picks.name: Micron Technology
picks.reason: Down ~7% midday as traders unwind Nvidia-rival chip bets before earnings; under 712 extends toward 698, back over 740 the fade fails.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down ~2% near 159.5 (prior close 162.85) on Huang-exit turmoil and target cuts a day before earnings; under 155.5 extends, a reclaim of Friday's close kills the put.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Down another ~4-5% premarket after Friday's ~9% drop as Asian chips slid; losing the 500 round number extends, but the stretched move keeps bounce risk high.

picks.name: Johnson & Johnson
picks.reason: Up ~1% on the Ollin Biosciences deal and a defensive rotation out of tech; over 291.5 extends, losing Friday's 285.75 close fails.
